items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: my first teacher on trombone was Gene Ware

ctx.x: Did you have a regular method, you had to learn to read and all?
Oh definitely, definitely, see, because in the meantime I was learning, I was going, my first teacher on trombone was Gene Ware, because I used to rehearse at the house with my brother, see.
